patch_description:
Add a wrap-around CZ gate followed by a parametrized CRZ gate connecting the last qubit (7) back to the first qubit (0). This creates a ring topology instead of a linear chain, enabling:
1. Long-range information flow between boundary qubits
2. Better generalization through improved quantum entanglement structure
3. Potential faster convergence via enhanced connectivity

This single new parameter (crz_wrap) leverages the proven CRZ effectiveness from the reverse chain section while testing ring-topology benefits on generalization gap (currently 0.03, target ≤0.02). The minimal gate overhead is justified by addressing the convergence slowdown (330 vs 180 steps in prior runs) through structural improvements.
